gui.buildminions.no_files: No blueprints found. Drop your schematic files into the schematics folder and press Refresh.
gui.buildminions.pick_file: Pick a blueprint on the left to see its size, block count and build time.
gui.buildminions.too_big: Not enough durability! It will break after %s blocks.
gui.buildminions.busy: The minion is busy – cancel its build first.
gui.buildminions.no_blueprint: No blueprint loaded – pick one in the Blueprints tab.
gui.buildminions.placing: Position the hologram in the world
message.buildminions.done: §aYour minion finished the build! §7(%s placed, %s skipped)
message.buildminions.broke: §c%s fell apart after placing %s blocks. Leftover materials were dropped.
message.buildminions.will_break: §eHeads up: the minion can only place %s more blocks, this blueprint has %s. It will break before finishing!
message.buildminions.bad_blueprint: §cThe minion could not read that blueprint.
message.buildminions.no_hologram: §cHologram data missing (did you reconnect?). Load the blueprint again.
gui.buildminions.upgrade.0: No upgrade (feed a Golden Apple for x2 durability)
gui.buildminions.upgrade.1: ★ Golden Apple upgrade (x2). Enchanted Golden Apple → x4
message.buildminions.upgraded: §6✦ %s upgraded! It can now place up to §e%s§6 blocks.
message.buildminions.already_upgraded: §7This minion already has this upgrade (or a better one).
gui.buildminions.no_workstation: Place a Minion Workstation within 8 blocks of the minion. It will craft, smelt and cut missing materials from the raw ones you give it (logs → planks → stairs, cobbled deepslate → deepslate...).
gui.buildminions.workstation_recipe: Recipe: iron ingots, crafting table, Minion Core, furnace and planks
gui.buildminions.nothing_craftable: Nothing to craft yet. Deposit raw materials (logs, stone, cobbled deepslate...) and they will show up here.
message.buildminions.nothing_to_craft: §7Nothing can be crafted from the materials the minion has.
